documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: PLA Sparkle
Bambu PLA Sparkle Safety Data Sheet SDS20251127A08
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PLA Sparkle
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values (dry state); the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 32 ± 2 MPa, elongation 6.8 ± 0.6 %, bending modulus 2150 ± 110 with no unit printed, bending strength 51 ± 2 MPa, impact 10.3 ± 0.7 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density, melting and glass transition temperatures are raw-material properties (ISO 1183, DSC) and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

TDS facts not stored (no registry key): Young's modulus (X-Y 1940 ± 230 MPa, Z 1660 ± 210 MPa), melt index (34.2 ± 3.3 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature (N/A), saturated water absorption rate (0.44 % at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed with desiccant), bed surface preparation (PVP glue), retraction length (0.6 - 1.0 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), max overhang angle (55°), max bridging length (30 mm), spool material (ABS, temperature resistance 70 °C) and spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows. The heat deflection temperature at 0.45 MPa (55 °C) is not stored because thermal.heat_deflection_temp holds the 1.8 MPa row; the support material is the "Support for PLA" relation.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting.
The TDS "Bed Surface Preparation PVP Glue" is a recommended setting, not a stated requirement, so no "requires" relation is written; no cached source says which store product is PVP glue.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: CLP "Not classified", and "Not hazardous goods" for sea (IMDG), DOT, road (ADR/RID) and air (ICAO/IATA) transport. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values. The SDS model "A08-xx" (p.2, section 1: "Model : A08-xx(xx stands for any suffix)") is not written to identity.model: it is a code pattern with a wildcard suffix, not this product's model, and identity.model comes from the reviewed identity map ("PLA Sparkle"), which a curated official_doc row would outrank and replace.

The material-table wiki's "PLA" values (nozzle 190 - 240 °C ±10 °C; bed 35 - 45 ℃ on the Cool Plate / PLA Plate and 45 - 65 ℃ on the Engineering (glue required), Smooth PEI / High-Temperature and Textured PEI plates; blast-oven drying 55 ℃ for 8 h, AMS 2 Pro / AMS HT drying 45 ℃ for 12 h) are for standard PLA: the page lists PLA Sparkle among the particle-filled materials (2. Nozzle), and its AMS table note ② excludes PLA Sparkle from "PLA". No row names PLA Sparkle, so they are not applied to this product.

Nozzle guidance disagreement left to review: the material-table wiki (2. Nozzle) names PLA Sparkle among particle-filled materials for which a hardened steel nozzle is to be used (0.4 mm hardened steel "highly recommended as the first choice") and stainless steel or brass nozzles avoided; the store page and the PLA wiki exclude only the 0.2 mm nozzle. The guideline's product-specific recommendation (a 0.4 mm hardened steel nozzle "highly recommended as the first choice" for Bambu PLA Sparkle) is stored as its own compatible_with relation; no requires or not_compatible_with relation is written for nozzle material.
Marketing prose proves no number: "Special Sparkling Look", "Relatively High Impact Strength" (store page) and "combines strength and sparkle" (TDS Basic Info) are not stored as values.
Hex: all 6 store colours have exactly one hex cell, matched by the colour name without the code in parentheses.

The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/088f0999da0c419a9630876c48842088.pdf) that was not cached and not read, so safety.certifications is neither curated nor marked not_published.
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) is the store page's own row (Product Features › bullet 4); the TDS gives no tolerance, so it is not restated here and not marked not_published.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).
The store FAQ (3.Safety Tips) says the filament "is not food-grade"; no registry key holds it.

Adjudication against the second extraction (71 field disagreements): locator wording ("p.1, Specifications › …" kept over "p.1 › Specifications › …"), the hex locators, the AMS-series and all-printers family targets (target_family kept) and the store-page source of the 0.2 mm nozzle exclusion keep this file's form. thermal.heat_deflection_temp stays the TDS 1.8 MPa row (53 °C), as in every other filament file; the 0.45 MPa row (55 °C) is noted. material.spool_type stays the store page's "Basic Reusable Spool" (unverified): the TDS rows give the spool's material and size, not its type. Not added: thermal.chamber_temp (see the chamber note), identity.model from the SDS (see the SDS note) and a separate not_compatible_with "Hotend with Stainless Steel Nozzle 0.2 mm" (the same fact as the 0.2 mm nozzle relation, whose note cites the store FAQ and the PLA wiki tip). Added from the second extraction after reading the documents: the "Support for PLA" relation (TDS p.2) and the "0.4 mm hardened steel nozzle" relation (material-table wiki, 2. Nozzle). material.net_weight is written as 1 kg (the TDS's own number) so its quote carries the value; the merge stores 1000 g. Field tally: 37 the same fact written differently, 24 kept as this file has it, 10 taken from the second extraction (the two added relations); none removed. Every value, quote and locator was re-read in the cached TDS, SDS, hex table, both wikis and the store page.
